longTitle: Vietnam Overtook Indonesia. With a Third of the People.
sources: Sources: World Bank WDI (NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD, NY.GDP.PCAP.CD, NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD, NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG, NE.EXP.GNFS.ZS, TX.VAL.MRCH.CD.WT, TX.VAL.TECH.MF.ZS, BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS, TX.VAL.FUEL.ZS.UN, TX.VAL.MMTL.ZS.UN, SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS, HD.HCI.OVRL, NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, SI.POV.DDAY, SP.POP.65UP.TO.ZS, SP.DYN.TFRT.IN); USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 (nickel); Vietnam customs (exports to the US, Jan–Nov 2025).

clips.title: Vietnam made $99 a person in 1990. Now it's passed Indonesia #Shorts
clips.desc: In 1990 Indonesia was almost 6× richer per person. In 2025 Vietnam passed it (World Bank).

clips.hook: A third of the people, *more exports*
clips.title: Vietnam exports more than Indonesia with a third of the people #Shorts
clips.desc: Exports ≈ 98% of Vietnam's GDP vs 23% in Indonesia (World Bank, 2025).
